note: Real questions a reader of this product would ask, grouped by who is asking and why. An expectation is about the OUTCOME, never a label: 'answered' means facts came back, 'declined' means the engine said what it could not do, 'asked' means it needed one more thing. A scenario whose honest outcome is a decline is marked so, because a corpus that expects an answer to an unanswerable question teaches the wrong lesson.

scenarios.note: Springfield, Nilgiris is a real place in Tamil Nadu and the only one of that name in the Indian catalogue. The engine resolves it and says so in the opening sentence. An earlier expectation here assumed the name was foreign and reported the product working as a defect.
